title: BreadcrumbList structured data
knob:
вставить в конец `<body>` скрипт JSON‑LD:
```json
{
"@context":"https://schema.org",
"@type":"BreadcrumbList",
"itemListElement":[
{"@type":"ListItem","position":1,"name":"Главная","item":"https://example.com/"},
{"@type":"ListItem","position":2,"name":"Лендинг Савелий","
variants:
вставить в конец `<body>` скрипт JSON‑LD:
```json
{
"@context":"https://schema.org",
"@type":"BreadcrumbList",
"itemListElement":[
{"@type":"ListItem","position":1,"name":"Главная","item":"https://example.com/"},
{"@type":"ListItem","position":2,"name":"Лендинг Савелий","

В конец `<body>` (перед закрывающим `</body>`) вставить скрипт:
```html
<script type="application/ld+json">
{
"@context":"https://schema.org",
"@type":"BreadcrumbList",
"itemListElement":[
{"@type":"ListItem","position":1,"name":"Главная","item":"https://example.com/"},
{"@type":"ListItem","position":2,"name":"Лендинг","item":"https://example.com/#price"}
]
}
</script>
```
(заменить `example.com` на реальный домен).
